name: M1 — Mobile shell: navigation always reachable + one viewport source of truth
description:
MILESTONE M1 (blocked: needs the strategy decision task).
Vertical slice: "on a phone I can always reach any module, and every screen has a title and a way back".

SCOPE (adjust to the chosen strategy after the decision)
- One viewport source of truth replacing the two conflicting definitions (src/store/ui.js handleResize <=1024 vs src/App.vue <768): a single composable/getter used by both the shell and the screens.
- One shared mobile page shell: app bar (title, back, contextual action, project switcher) + persistent navigation trigger; a page container that owns scrolling and padding.
- Fix the unreachable drawer: the navigation trigger lives in the shell (not inside the off-canvas panel) and survives route changes.
- Deep-linkable payloads: replace the in-memory setPendingParams hand-off for the apps that need objects (chat, team, team-channel, team-dm, team-media-library, workspace) with a reload-safe path (id in the URL + fetch on mount).
- Remove orphan/legacy mobile code touched by the shell: src/components/mobile/MenuBar.vue, unused SplitView/Splitter references if confirmed unused.
- Phone never mounts the dockview workspace: .../desktop resolves to a single-screen route on small viewports.

OUT OF SCOPE
Per-screen redesigns (tasks, chat, settings) — those are M2–M4.

DEPLOYABLE + DEMOABLE
Deployable behind the existing routes (no new backend). Demo: on a 390 px device, navigate to 5 different modules and back, refresh on a chat deep link and land on the same chat.

ACCEPTANCE
- No screen is unreachable from the shell; every screen shows a title and a back affordance where a stack exists.
- One and only one definition of phone/tablet/desktop width in the codebase.
- Deep link + refresh keeps the contextual object (chat/team).
